name: Futa Ane ~Bitter & Sweet~
source:
Yuuichi lives with his older sisters, Mikoto and Haruna. Though they don't have their parents, they live a peaceful life. Just before summer holiday, Wakaba, his classmate, suddenly says to him, "I love you, please be my boyfriend." Yuuichi likes Wakaba, but... After long consideration, he decides to date her. Wakaba is happy to hear that and soon tells Mikoto and Haruna about it. Yuuichi can see surprise, confusion and sadness on their faces...

Through summer holiday, whom will Yuuichi choose as his girlfriend? Wakaba, Mikoto or Haruna?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
雄一与他的姐姐美琴和榛名住在一起。虽然没有父母，但他们过着平静的生活。暑假前夕，他的同学若叶突然对他说：“我爱你，请做我的男朋友吧。”雄一喜欢若叶，但是……经过深思熟虑，他决定和她约会。若叶听到这个消息很高兴，并很快将这件事告诉了美琴和榛名。佑一在他们的脸上看到了惊讶、困惑和悲伤……

暑假期间，佑一会选择谁作为女友呢？若叶、美琴还是榛名？

[来自工口游戏商店]
